cases.title: Verify clicking "Preview & save" on a valid Create perk form opens the "App preview" modal
Verify the "App preview" modal renders both the Card perks tile view and the perk detail screen
Verify the "App preview" device frame measures 375 x 812 (iPhone 13 mini)
Verify scrolling within the device frame reveals all remaining perk detail content
Verify tapping a detail-screen section header expands and collapses that section
Verify the tile preview shows only the new perk's own category and tile, excluding all other categories and perks
Verify selecting the "Arabic" preview language renders the preview in Arabic with correct RTL layout
Verify selecting the "English" preview language returns the preview to English with LTR layout
Verify the "App preview" modal opens with English pre-selected as the default preview language
Verify clicking "Save" in the "App preview" modal creates the perk and it appears in the perks list
Verify clicking "Cancel" in the "App preview" modal closes it without saving and keeps the form data
Verify clicking "Preview & save" with missing mandatory fields blocks the preview and shows field-level errors
Verify every entered Create perk field renders in the correct place in the preview (Merchant cashback)
Verify the Coupon code section renders with the coupon code chip for a "Discount/coupon" perk
Verify the perk cover image and logo render correctly in both preview views
Verify closing the "App preview" modal with the X icon restores the Create perk page cleanly
Verify the preview reflects the Create perk form values at the moment the modal is opened
Verify maximum-length content does not break the preview layout, scrolling or the "See more" expander
Verify optional sections left empty are omitted from the perk detail preview
Verify a failed save keeps the "App preview" modal open, preserves the data and surfaces an error message
Verify the existing Create perk form and publish flow are not regressed by the "App preview" modal
Verify the "App preview" modal visual fidelity matches the Figma design in English and Arabic
